Studio

Spaces that reflect who you are.

Sri Sankalp Interio focuses on transforming interiors into thoughtfully designed spaces that balance beauty, comfort and functionality. Every project begins with how you actually live — then shapes the layout, materials and light around it.

What We Design

From a single room to a full residence, each space is planned around function first, then finished with character.

Residential Interiors

Homes, apartments and complete residential spaces, planned around how you live day to day.

Modular Kitchens

Modern kitchen concepts designed around functionality, storage and everyday lifestyle.

Bedroom Interiors

Elegant, comfortable and personalised bedroom spaces built around rest and routine.

Living Spaces

Contemporary living rooms designed for comfort, gathering and visual character.

Commercial Interiors

Professional, attractive spaces for offices, studios and client-facing businesses.

Custom Interior Solutions

Design concepts tailored entirely to your requirements, space and budget.

How We Work

A consistent process from first conversation to finished space.

01

Discover

Understand the client's space, lifestyle and requirements.

02

Concept

Develop the initial design direction.

03

Visualise

Present the design through visual concepts and layouts.

04

Adjust materials, layouts and details based on feedback.

05

Execute

Bring the approved concept into reality.

06

Deliver

Complete the space with attention to finishing and detail.
